desc: Tasks and calendar for any CalDAV server you supply (Radicale, Nextcloud, Baikal, Fastmail and others), plus read-only .ics calendar subscriptions for Google, Outlook and Apple, which need no server at all. Lasso handwriting in NOTE to capture it as a task or a calendar event, or create and edit tasks and events on device. Find searches the keywords and starred pages already recorded in your daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly and meeting notes. Your task and event content, and the login you enter, are sent only to the server address you configure - no other destination. Settings are stored in Document/TaskHub/settings.json, and daily and meeting notes are created in folders you choose. Network access is used for your server; file read/write for those notes and settings, and to read keywords and starred pages from notes in the folders you configure.
name: Task Hub
author: Sparkinman
